recurrence_persistence.definition: trailing mean of current-state distance-weighted recurrence
recurrence_persistence.local_scale: median positive admissible pair distance in the causal geometry window

crystallized_fraction.definition: causal count of CRYSTALLIZED geometry-ready windows divided by elapsed geometry-ready windows

state_machine.reset: any window not satisfying CRYSTALLIZING resets crystallizing duration to zero

claim_boundary: Version 3 was specified after exploratory inspection of versions 1 and 2 and remains exploratory.
Recurrent dwell is retained only in the inherited diagnostic record and cannot affect the state machine.
Continuous coordinates remain separately reportable; the categorical state never substitutes for them.
All distances are normalized by a causal local scale and all thresholds are identical across models.
Saved numeric observations are reused; no LLM receives observer information.
